signin.title: Signing in
signin.a1: Use your company work account. If you work for more than one company, the company switcher at the top of the menu changes which company you are working in.
signin.q2: How do I change the language?
signin.a2: Open the account menu (your name, top right) and choose English or العربية. The portal remembers your choice on this device.
signin.q3: I cannot sign in. What now?
signin.a3: Check that you are using your work account and the right password. If it still fails, open a ticket with IT and say which device and network you are on.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.q1: How do I book a room?
rooms.a1: Open Rooms, pick a day and a time, choose a free room and confirm. You can also use "Find a room" to search by time, number of people and equipment.
rooms.q2: Can I change or cancel a booking?
rooms.a2: Yes. Open the booking from Rooms and choose Cancel. Cancel rooms you no longer need so others can use them.
rooms.q3: Why can I not book on a Friday or Saturday?
rooms.a3: The working week runs Sunday to Thursday. Rooms are booked within working hours only.

tickets.title: Support tickets
tickets.q1: How do I ask IT for help?
tickets.a1: Open Tickets, choose New ticket, pick what is wrong, say how urgent it is and describe it. You can paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.
tickets.q2: How do I follow my ticket?
tickets.a2: Open Tickets to see your tickets and their status. You are notified when IT replies or the status changes.
tickets.q3: My problem came back. Can I reopen it?
tickets.a3: Yes, within 7 days of a ticket being resolved. After that, open a new ticket and mention the old number.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.q1: Where do I see company news?
announcements.a1: Open Announcements. Pinned posts stay at the top and the number beside the menu item counts what you have not read.
announcements.a2: Each post is written for one company, a few, or everyone. You see the ones meant for you.
announcements.q3: Can I get a message when something important is posted?
announcements.a3: Yes. Pinned announcements notify you in the bell and by email, unless you switch that off in your notification settings.

directory.title: Directory
directory.q1: How do I find a colleague?
directory.a1: Open Directory or use the search box at the top. Type a name, a job title or a department.
directory.q2: What can I see about a person?
directory.a2: Their job title, department, company, office and how to reach them. Select a person to open their card.
directory.q3: Something about me is wrong. Who fixes it?
directory.a3: Your details come from the company directory. Open a ticket with IT and say what should change.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.a1: Click the bell at the top. "See all" opens the full list, where you can mark everything as read.
notifications.a2: Open the bell, then Settings. For tickets, bookings and announcements you can switch the portal and the email on or off separately.
notifications.q3: I did not get an email I expected.
notifications.a3: Check your notification settings and your junk folder. The portal always shows the notification in the bell.

install.title: Install on a phone
install.q1: Can I put the portal on my home screen?
install.a1: Yes. In Chrome on Android open the menu (three dots) and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen". On iPhone use Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.q2: Does it work with a weak signal?
install.a2: The portal loads quickly and keeps what you last opened. With no signal it says so and shows your last saved view; changes need a connection.
install.a3: It updates itself. When a new version is ready a banner offers "Update now".
